data.description: A living wall can choose to make a free combat maneuver check with a successful slam attack. If successful, this check pushes a creature 5 feet directly away as with a bull rush. This ability only works on creatures of a size equal to or smaller than the pushing creature. Creatures pushed in this way do not provoke attacks of opportunity and stop if the push would move them into a solid object or creature.
